messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] ded-pool-node-7 (rg-dpool-us-west-2) reported ECC spike -> GPU panic at 02:12 UTC. Affected tenants: ArcadiaHealth (vpc-22), small request error spike. Pager: oncall-sre.
jlee: taking pager. looking at node now. can someone confirm if this is thermal or ECC? any preemption event?
mrodriguez: node shows ECC errors in dmesg and a BMC reset ~02:11. no graceful shutdown. gpu driver logged \"gpu_ecc_uncorrectable\".
eng-runtime: load on that pool spiked due to batch jobs. autoscaler didn't move because node went unresponsive. checking routing fallback.
jlee: isolating node from pool: running `rbctl node set-evict rg-dpool-node-7 --reason "ecc-panic"` -> starting drain.
mrodriguez: running drain: `kubectl drain rg-dpool-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60` will start moving containers. also marking as no-burst in pool config.
eng-ml: ArcadiaHealth has a long-running streaming chat model. suggest routing new requests to quantized-variant (gpt-j-small-q4) to reduce pressure while rebalancing.
eng-runtime: can set temporary routing policy: `route: prefer=quantized-variant, fallback=hosted-small` for customer arcadiahealth. applying now.
account-se: preparing customer notification. ArcadiaHealth ops should be told about degraded throughput and expected 18-30m mitigation window. @support please draft.
support: Draft msg: "We observed a GPU hardware fault in your dedicated pool. We've isolated the affected node and are rebalancing traffic. You may see increased latency for ongoing streams; we'll provide ETA for replacement within 30 minutes." want to add metrics link?
jlee: yes include dashboard link and mention failover to quantized model. `https://console.redwood/redwood/arcadia/dedpool/rg-dpool-us-west-2`.
mrodriguez: node drain progressing. 6/8 pods rescheduled, 2 blocked on local checkpoint copy. copying artifacts off node: `rsync /var/checkpoints/arcadia/* to s3://arcadia-checkpoints/tmp/`.
eng-runtime: enabling short-circuit cache for ArcadiaHealth to reduce token generation load: TTL 5m.
eng-ml: also disabling KV-cache persistence for active sessions on that node to avoid corruption during move.
account-se: Arcadia ops replied: "Thanks — seeing a small spike in 5xx, appreciate updates." asked for ETA and whether customer traffic will be routed to other regions.
support: respond: "No cross-region failover yet — routing to quantized variant in same region to keep latency predictable. ETA for node replacement 25-40m. We'll update in 10m." sending now.
jlee: handing pager to @mrodriguez for hardware replacement steps, I'll stay for postmortem notes. @mrodriguez take over.
mrodriguez: ack. coordinating with infra on RM ticket #RM-9482 to RMA GPU board. BMC reports nvram errors; will attempt BMC firmware reload if RMA delayed.
eng-runtime: monitoring steady-state after reroute. p50 latency for ArcadiaHealth climbed from 120ms -> 310ms after incident, now down to 220ms with quantized fallback. token rate reduced ~38%.
eng-ml: quality regression checks show a 0.6% decrease in rouge for the quantized path on our guard prompts — acceptable short-term.
account-se: updating Arcadia ops: "Traffic is routed to quantized variant in-region; latency improving. Replacement ETA ~30m. We'll send final confirmation once node is replaced and rebalanced."
support: Arcadia acknowledged. they asked for post-incident runbook entries — will coordinate with product to document.
mrodriguez: attempted BMC firmware reload `ipmitool -H bmc-rg-dpool-node-7 -U admin -P **** mc reset cold` -> BMC didn't come back. infra advised RMA.
mrodriguez: infra scheduled RMA slot at 03:05 UTC. spare node will be provisioned and joined to pool then. tracking RM-9482.
jlee: noted. set incident severity to S2 and create incident ticket INC-2026-487.
eng-runtime: once node replaced, recommend rolling restart of pool to re-enable KV persistence and burst settings.
jlee: closing pager handover. I'll follow up on postmortem. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: [RESOLVED] rg-dpool-node-7 removed from pool and RMA scheduled. incident status updated to "mitigated" at 03:25 UTC.
jlee: final note for postmortem: investigate autoscaler sensitivity to sudden ECC-induced node loss; add automatic retry for blocked reschedules (checkpoint copies).
summary: ArcadiaHealth dedicated pool GPU node ECC panic -> drain, reroute to quantized variant, customer notified, RMA scheduled
